purpose: Define the Chapter 1 empirical statistics that a more realistic Chapter 2 numerical world should reproduce. These targets are external to izu-core and are not modified to accommodate Model 3R outcomes.

display_holdout.role: not used to fit Model3R v1 ecological parameters; used as a prediction/adequacy check after the recurrent functional core is fitted
display_holdout.northern_midlatitude: red_pink declines in both evidence scopes; no FDR-supported colour-conditioned architecture

primary_reproduction_requirements: model-implied pollen limitation increases with standardized isolation
model-implied reproductive assurance isolation slopes are positive in all four contexts
model-implied floral generalization isolation slopes are positive in all four contexts
generalization remains positively associated with isolation after conditioning on assurance in all four contexts
model-implied assurance is negatively associated with current pollen limitation
model-implied generalization is negatively associated with current pollen limitation

quantitative_adequacy.H3_rule: simulated H3 beta must fall within the empirical estimate +/- 2 SE
quantitative_adequacy.H4_assurance_rule: simulated assurance-to-PL beta must fall within empirical estimate +/- 2 SE after observation-scale standardization
quantitative_adequacy.H4_generalization_rule: simulated generalization-to-PL beta must fall within empirical estimate +/- 2 SE after observation-scale standardization
quantitative_adequacy.H1_H2_rule: sign recurrence across all four contexts is required first; magnitude fit is scored second and cannot rescue a sign failure

claim_boundary: The target statistics are contemporary macroecological associations, not longitudinal within-lineage evolutionary rates.
Matching these targets would establish empirical emulation of Chapter 1 summary structure, not proof that the simulated historical pathway generated the natural data.
The display holdout is not available for parameter tuning in Model3R v1.
Natural island-specific parameter values remain unidentified unless independently measured.
